summary: Preinstall script exfiltrates installer host identifiers via HTTP POST and DNS tunneling
details: preinstall.js runs automatically on npm install and collects installer host identifiers (hostname, username, cwd, install path, process.platform, node version, npm user-agent, package name and version) and transmits them to hardcoded external destinations. Identifiers are POSTed over HTTPS and HTTP to the interactsh out-of-band collector dae7n4pijsh1ahi9684gu8get3kaiefc9.oast.online and to the bare IP 5.189.159.252, and are additionally hex-encoded and concatenated as DNS labels under oast.online and resolved via dns.lookup so identifiers exfiltrate through the resolver path even when direct HTTP egress is blocked. A hardcoded token string 'swisscom-oce-3b9f1c7a2e' and the package name pattern are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe against an internal Swisscom scope; the self-label as bug-bounty research does not change that installer host metadata is transmitted to third-party infrastructure without consent.
